title_en: Visions of the Future (17/20): Green Cities and Ruined Worlds
note_en: 有的…有的… splits a group into parts, like English "some… others…": 有的描绘绿色城市…，有的则描绘被海水淹没的废墟世界 "some depicted green cities…, while others depicted ruined worlds swallowed by the sea." The 则 in the second clause adds a note of contrast, like "while" or "on the other hand"; the text uses the same pattern with 一部分作品… 另一部分作品则… "some works… other works…".

sentences.en: Xiao Le says, "This is different from all the other exhibits we've seen today — flying cars, robots, atomic energy were all just guesses about what the future would be like, but this exhibit says the answer is actually in our own hands."
